new_jobs.title: AI-Driven Data Architect
new_jobs.description:
Are you a hands-on Data Architect
who thrives in an AI-first world – designing modern data platforms, leveraging AI-driven development
, and shaping how organizations turn data into intelligent action? Do you combine strong data engineering foundations with a software engineering mindset, and enjoy building, not just designing?

Here at Nortal, you will play a key role in shaping and advancing our data expertise and designing solutions
for our clients in Europe. You will work alongside top professionals in data and AI development
in Finland, collaborating with global data and software teams to design impactful solutions that drive business value.

What You'll Do

Design and implement AI-enabled data architectures and solutions on modern lakehouse platforms (Microsoft Fabric and Azure Databricks)
Apply AI-assisted and agent-driven design and development approaches to accelerate data platform and data product delivery
Combine data engineering, software engineering and DevOps practices (IaC, CI/CD, testing, versioning, modular design)
Define and enforce data strategy, governance, standards and architectural guidelines
Work closely with technical and business teams to ensure alignment
Nurture a culture of collaboration and knowledge sharing
Support pre-sales and solution design, contributing to customer engagements and proposals.

What Makes You a Great Fit

Experience in designing data architecture as part of enterprise architecture and data strategy
Familiarity with data mesh paradigm and principles
Knowledge of various data architectures, including data lakes, data warehouses, and lakehouses
Experience with cloud and on-premise data solutions using Microsoft technologies, including strong hands-on work with Microsoft Fabric (preferred) or Databricks lakehouse platforms
Hands-on experience and/or strong understanding of working with agentic AI development and software delivery methodologies, e.g. agentic swarm coding and spec-driven development.
Experience applying software engineering practices (e.g. version control, CI/CD, testing) in data environments
Experience on hands-on software engineering & general software architecture design is a big plus
Pre-GenAI proficiency in Python and SQL
Fluent in both Finnish and English

We value the following certifications

Microsoft Fabric Data Engineer Associate
Microsoft Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate
Databricks Data Engineer Associate or Professional
Azure Solutions Architect Expert

Why join Nortal?

We value individuals not just for their skills, but also for their cultural alignment. Our core values include a commitment to delivering value and results, taking ownership, empowering oneself and others, and owning your future and growth. In addition to our professionalism, we appreciate a touch of good humor!
We prioritize your growth and development. At Nortal, we actively support constant improvement and knowledge sharing through our Capability teams, both internal and external training opportunities, self-learning, a mentorship program, and strong 1:1 culture.
We prioritize your health and well-being by offering a flexible range of benefits, including adaptable working hours, access to high-quality occupational healthcare, massage services, and bicycle benefit. We are also a remote friendly company.

Nortal’s offices are located in Helsinki, Turku, Oulu, Uusikaupunki, and Jyväskylä. This position can be worked from any of the previous, but we are pretty flexible with remote work as well.

Interested?

Apply here or contact our recruiter Virpi directly at virpi.kivinen(at)nortal.com

Nortal values equality and diversity in our work community. We are hoping to get applicants with different backgrounds, such as in regard to age, gender, language, culture or minority group.

About FullStack

FullStack is your AI-native engineering partner, built to turn AI capability into certainty. Most companies can demo AI; few can get it to production and prove what it produced. We close that gap with three capabilities, AI built into your products from the start, elite vetted talent who apply it, and transparent execution that shows value every step of the way. With now over 600 customers in North America, FullStack is one integrated partner for all your AI engineering needs. With FullStack, you move forward with confidence.

We’re Most Proud Of

Offering life-changing career opportunities to talented software professionals across the Americas.
Building highly-skilled software development teams for hundreds of the world’s greatest companies.
Having delivered hundreds of successful custom software solutions, which have positively impacted the lives and careers of millions of users.
Our 4.1-star rating on GlassDoor.
Our client Net Promoter Score of 68, twice the industry average.

The Opportunity

Join our talent network and connect with U.S. clients for flexible, project-based development work as a Senior Software Engineer (.NET + Vue).

You will integrate directly into our client's team and work alongside their existing designers and engineers on a daily basis.

What We're Looking For

5+ years of professional software development experience.
Advanced English is required.
Successful completion of a four-year college degree is required.
Deep expertise in C# and .NET with extensive experience building production software.
Proven experience developing modern web applications with Vue, with strong React or Angular experience also considered.
Strong experience designing, deploying, and operating production systems on Microsoft Azure with a focus on scalability, reliability, and cost optimization.
Solid background working with SQL Server, including schema design, query optimization, and performance tuning.
Hands-on experience using Claude Code or similar AI-assisted development tools as a core part of the software engineering workflow.
Proven experience using AI tools for activities such as prototyping, code generation, testing, debugging, refactoring, and technical documentation.
Strong experience writing clean, maintainable, and well-tested production code.
Experience participating actively in code reviews and maintaining high engineering quality standards.
Strong collaboration skills and a product-minded approach, with experience partnering directly with Product, Design, and Customer Success.
Experience mentoring engineers and participating in pair programming or collaborative development.
Familiarity with CRM or other data-intensive platforms is a plus.
Experience with Datadog, Playwright, or similar observability and testing tools is a plus.
Experience with CI/CD and frequent production deployments is a plus.
Ability to work through new and difficult issues and contribute to libraries as needed.
Ability to create and maintain continuous integration and delivery of applications.
Forensic attention to detail.
A positive mindset and a can-do attitude.
Experience working on Agile/Scrum teams.
Meaningful experience working on large, complex systems.
Ability to take extreme ownership over your work. Every day is a challenge to ensure you are performing to the expectations you and your team have agreed upon.
Ability to identify with the goals of FullStack's clients, and dedicate yourself to delivering on the commitments your team make to them.

Nice To Have

We’re Seeking Engineers Who Are AI-enthusiastic In Their Workflow. Professional Experience Or Personal Project Work With The Following Is a Significant Plus

Cursor, Windsurf, or Google Antigravity.
Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Codex, or Copilot CLI.

Work Authorization Requirements

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the country of this job posting on a full-time basis.
FullStack will not sponsor applicants for work visas now or in the future.

What We Offer

Competitive pay.
100% remote work.
The ability to work with leading startups and Fortune 500 companies.
Continuing education opportunities.
Opportunity to grow and expand your career.

Our talent network is committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and accessible environment where IT professionals can find opportunities that match their skills. We welcome individuals of all races, religions, genders, sexual orientations, national origins, abilities, and experiences. Our focus is on connecting talent with projects based on qualifications, ensuring a fair and transparent process that values diverse perspectives and global collaboration.

is responsible for designing, developing, implementing, and supporting AI-powered solutions that improve business processes, employee experiences, and operational efficiency across Arcadis.

.

This position is ideal for a developer who is passionate about emerging AI technologies and enjoys combining software development, automation, integration, and problem-solving to deliver practical business solutions.

Role accountabilities:

Develop, test, and deploy AI-powered applications, copilots, agents, and automation solutions.
Build solutions using Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Copilot Studio, and Microsoft Power Platform technologies.
Develop integrations between AI solutions and enterprise systems through APIs, MCP tools, custom connectors, and other integration technologies.
Assist in creating reusable components, templates, and development patterns that support scalable solution delivery.
Support the implementation of Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), prompt engineering, document ingestion, and knowledge search capabilities.
Support proof-of-concept and pilot initiatives to evaluate emerging AI technologies and capabilities.
Participate in Agile delivery processes, including sprint planning, development, testing, and deployment activities.
Document solutions, integrations, and technical processes to support ongoing operations and future development.
Follow established security, privacy, and compliance standards in the design and delivery of AI solutions.
Support implementation of Responsible AI practices, including content safety, transparency, and governance requirements.
Work with cybersecurity and platform teams to ensure secure access to enterprise data and services.

Qualifications & Experience:

2–5 years of experience in software development, automation, application development, or related technical roles.
Experience developing solutions using at least one modern programming language such as Python, C#, JavaScript, or TypeScript.
Experience building integrations using APIs, web services, or cloud platforms.
Familiarity with Azure cloud services and modern development practices.
Understanding of AI, machine learning, generative AI, or intelligent automation concepts.

Experience working within Agile development teams.

Experience with Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Copilot Studio, Microsoft Power Platform, or similar AI platforms - nice to have
Experience developing MCP tools, custom connectors, plugins, or API-based integrations - nice to have

Join Arcadis. Create a Legacy.

new_jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer - Identity & Access Management
new_jobs.description:
The salary range for this role is negotiable, the range being $6,000-$11,000 per month (Gross in USD), based on location and experience level.

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

Compensation
:

For this principal development role, with 12+ years of experience, the compensation range is $6000 - $11000
per month, negotiable based on the skills and experience being brought to the table. This range acknowledges the extensive expertise, leadership capabilities, and significant contributions expected at this level.

This is a fully remote role
. We believe the best engineers can do world-class work from anywhere, and we hire accordingly. You get principal-level scope and ownership at a growing fintech, competitive compensation, and no relocation or commute attached to it. Work from where you do your best work.

About the Role:

We are seeking a talented and motivated best-in-class Principal Software Engineer to own and lead the evolution of authentication and authorization at Sezzle. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

Sezzle is investing in the next generation of its authentication and authorization platform, centered on a purpose-built API auth gateway and a clean set of identity and access management services. As the Principal Software Engineer leading this effort, you will own the technical vision, architecture, and migration strategy for this transformation.

In this backend focused role, you will work closely with stakeholders from Product, Security, Support and the business. You’ll also partner with engineering teams across the organization to deliver auth capabilities that are safe, incremental to adopt, and invisible to customers. Your day-to-day responsibilities will include designing, developing, and delivering gateway and identity services, as well as unblocking and mentoring your teammates. Your work will generally focus on foundational platform capabilities, security-critical paths, and performance at the edge.

At Sezzle, AI-assisted development is a standard part of how we build, paired with the rigorous review and security discipline the auth-critical path demands. As a principal engineer, you will help set the pattern for how AI tooling is used well on security-sensitive systems.

Key Responsibilities

Own the technical vision and roadmap for Sezzle’s authentication and authorization platform, including a dedicated API auth gateway and supporting identity services.
Architect, design, and build scalable, highly-available auth services and gateway components primarily in Golang, leveraging AWS, RDS (MySQL/Postgres), and modern distributed patterns.
Design and lead phased, zero-downtime migrations of auth traffic and functionality, with clear rollback and safety mechanisms at every step.
Establish and evolve authentication and authorization standards across the platform: OAuth2/OIDC flows, token strategy (JWT, opaque, refresh), service-to-service auth (mTLS, workload identity), and fine-grained authorization models (RBAC/ABAC/policy engines).
Drive consistency and scalability across a distributed microservices architecture while maintaining the performance, reliability, and latency budgets expected of an edge gateway.
Partner with Security and Compliance to ensure the new platform meets fintech-grade security and regulatory requirements, and champion secure-by-default patterns across engineering.
Establish and evolve engineering best practices for observability, security, and CI/CD across teams, with particular rigor on the auth-critical path.
Participate in the on-call rotation for the services you own, and help lead incident response and postmortems on the auth-critical path.
Mentor engineers and champion a culture of learning, innovation, and operational excellence.
Collaborate cross-functionally to translate business goals into technical roadmaps and deliver results that matter.

Minimum Requirements:

12+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant backend experience.
Deployed significant changes to a production application in the past 30 days.
Deep, hands-on expertise in authentication and authorization systems: OAuth2, OpenID Connect, SAML, JWT and session-based auth, token lifecycle management, and modern authorization patterns (RBAC, ABAC, policy-as-code).
Experience designing, building, or operating an API gateway or auth proxy at scale: whether a commercial/open-source gateway (e.g., Kong, Envoy, AWS API Gateway, Traefik) or an in-house edge service.
Proven track record leading a large-scale service extraction or migration: decomposing a monolith or large legacy service into well-bounded services with zero or minimal customer impact.
Strong proficiency in Golang, with experience building and maintaining RESTful APIs.
Expertise with SQL-based RDBMS (MySQL, PostgreSQL) and experience optimizing schema and queries for performance at scale.
Solid understanding of distributed systems design patterns (e.g., transactional outbox, event-driven architecture, queues) and the specific challenges of high-throughput, low-latency edge services.
Demonstrated ability to bring new ideas forward, influence decisions, and lead complex technical initiatives across many teams.
Demonstrated AI-forward engineering: you actively use AI tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or custom LLM integrations) in your development work today, have opinions grounded in practice about where it helps and where it doesn't, and help teammates adopt AI-assisted workflows.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a similar technical field (required).

Preferred Knowledge and Skills:

Experience with identity platforms and standards implementations (e.g., Keycloak, Auth0, Okta, Ory, or in-house IdPs), and familiarity with fine-grained authorization approaches (policy-as-code, relationship-based access control) as we centralize authorization over time.
Experience with service mesh and edge technologies (Envoy, Istio, mTLS, rate limiting, WAF integration).
Familiarity with threat modeling, secure design review, and common auth attack vectors (token theft, replay, CSRF, session fixation, privilege escalation).
Proficiency in observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, New Relic), especially for latency-sensitive edge services.
Experience with AWS cloud infrastructure, mainly AWS Aurora RDS, both MySQL and Postgres.
Experience in fintech, payments, BNPL, or consumer lending - familiarity with financial compliance (PCI-DSS, SOC 2), credit decisioning, or transaction processing systems.
Experience with CI/CD pipelines and containerized microservices (Docker, Kubernetes).
Track record of shipping commercial APIs and platform infrastructure in high-growth environments.
Proven leadership in guiding technical direction, improving system reliability, and scaling engineering organizations.

About You:

You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things.
You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

new_jobs.title: AI Developer Experience Engineer
new_jobs.description:
About Us

Planet is a leading technology company transforming payments by putting customer experience first. We offer integrated solutions that include payment processing, VAT refunds, dynamic currency conversion, and management services for merchants in the Retail and Hospitality sectors worldwide.

In recent years, we have experienced significant growth, expanding our services and global presence.

With strong private equity investors, Advent International and Eurazeo, we have the financial capital and expertise to grow our capabilities and reach through acquisitions.

Our mission is to create a world of connected commerce where payments are simple, secure, and seamless, enabling our partners to deliver exceptional experiences to their customers.

Role Overview

This is a long-term fixed-term contract
designed to support Planet’s AI-first engineering scale-up project.

Planet is scaling AI-first engineering across its technology organisation, and the AI Enablement team is helping turn that ambition into day-to-day reality.

We are looking for Senior AI Developer Experience Engineers
to join the team and help drive adoption across Engineering. This is a hands-on role focused on AI Fluency, developer experience, internal enablement tooling, and measurable improvement across the software delivery lifecycle.

You will work closely with teams across Engineering, partnering directly with developers, QAs, product owners, scrum masters, business analysts, and managers to help them adopt better ways of working with AI. This is not a role from the sidelines. You will spend time with teams, understand where they struggle, coach them in practical contexts, and help embed better habits into real delivery work.

We are looking for people with strong engineering foundations who also bring a strong human touch. You should be someone who communicates clearly, builds trust easily, works well with different personalities, and knows how to bring people with you. Success in this role depends as much on credibility with engineers as it does on your ability to explain, facilitate, coach, and create momentum across the organisation.

You will help enable more than 300 engineers, alongside a broader set of SDLC roles, through structured AI Fluency sessions, hands-on pairing, internal agents and workflows, reusable guidance, and support for priority initiatives. Over time, the role will also help drive adoption of broader platform and toolchain capabilities that improve engineering effectiveness across Planet.

What You'll Do

Deliver AI Fluency sessions across Engineering and SDLC roles, from prompt engineering fundamentals to more advanced agentic coding workflows and practical AI-first ways of working
Work closely with teams across Engineering, building strong relationships, understanding where they struggle, and helping them adopt AI and better workflows in a practical, team-friendly way
Pair directly with developers and teams to improve adoption in real delivery work, helping them use tools such as GitHub Copilot, Copilot CLI, internal AI agents, workflow automations, and related capabilities effectively and responsibly.
Help maintain and improve internal enablement tooling, including AI agents, automations, templates, prompts, workflows, and supporting assets used across the organisation.
Create high-quality enablement content, including guides, templates, examples, recorded sessions, best practices, and role-specific learning material that teams can actually use.
Assess and track AI maturity across teams using Planet’s AI Fluency model, helping identify where support is needed and where stronger patterns can be scaled.
Support priority initiatives with dedicated AI-first coaching, helping delivery teams apply better workflows, better prompting, and more effective use of internal tools in live projects.
Collaborate closely with Architecture and Platform teams so enablement stays aligned with engineering standards, platform capabilities, system landscape, and the way Planet builds software.
Capture adoption signals, usage insights, and learning feedback, and feed these into the AI Centre of Excellence and broader leadership reporting.
Over time, help expand enablement beyond AI tooling into broader developer experience and platform adoption across the engineering toolchain.

Who You Are

Strong software engineering background, with experience building or maintaining production systems and a solid understanding of the full SDLC.
Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Copilot CLI, Cursor, Cody, Claude Code, or similar.
Excellent communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts clearly, run hands-on workshops, and adapt your style to different audiences across Engineering.
Strong interpersonal skills and a genuine human touch. You build trust, work well with different personalities, and enjoy helping teams improve in a practical and collaborative way.
Credibility with engineers. You are comfortable pairing with developers, discussing implementation trade-offs, and helping teams improve how they work in practice.
Experience creating strong technical content such as guides, tutorials, documentation, or internal learning material.
A genuine interest in developer experience, engineering productivity, and helping teams adopt better ways of working.

Nice to Have

Experience in developer experience, developer enablement, developer advocacy, or internal technical coaching.
Understanding of enterprise engineering environments, including APIs, system design patterns, CI/CD, observability, infrastructure, and engineering governance.
Strong understanding of prompt design, LLM capabilities, agentic workflows, and practical AI usage patterns in software engineering.
Experience defining or tracking adoption metrics, maturity models, developer productivity indicators, or ROI-oriented enablement measures.
Experience with workflow automation and internal tooling, including platforms such as N8N or similar.
Familiarity with fintech, payments, or regulated engineering environments.

Tech Environment

AI and enablement tools: GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Copilot CLI, internal AI agents, workflow automations

Engineering ecosystem: GitHub, Azure DevOps, Jira, Confluence, Terraform

Languages and stacks: Java, .NET, TypeScript, Python, and others across Planet teams

Why Planet

Planet is an equal opportunity employer where diversity is valued, and all employment is decided based on qualifications, merit, and business need.

Come and grow your career in the most exciting, fast-paced technology market, with a business that delivers feel-good connected commerce.

We would love to hear from you. Apply now.

At Planet, we embrace a hybrid work model, with three days a week in the office.

Reasonable accommodations may be made in order to allow for an individual to perform the essential functions of this role successfully.

ur success
